reviewText: The Example Bistro is our new favorite spot. The sarmale were incredible and the staff made us feel like family.
Great atmosphere at The Example Bistro and friendly service. The soup could have been a bit warmer but overall a lovely evening.
Waited almost 40 minutes for a table at The Example Bistro even though we had a reservation. The food was fine once it arrived.
Best papanasi in town, hands down. The Example Bistro nailed the dessert menu and the coffee was excellent too.
Ordered the mici at The Example Bistro and they were cold. Asked for a remake and never got a follow up from staff.
